title: Foreclassing: From Forecasts to Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2503.04956v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Time series forecasts are widely used to inform decisions under uncertainty. In many applications, these decisions involve classifying a time series based on outcomes that have yet to be observed. In this paper, we introduce Foreclassing, a new machine learning problem in which the class label of a time series is defined as a function of its future observations. We provide a mathematical formulation of Foreclassing and establish several theoretical results characterizing the problem. These results describe how additional future information affects Bayes classification risk, provide bounds on the classification error of learned Foreclassing models, and demonstrate how future observations used during training can yield finite-sample improvements over conventional classifiers. translated_abstract: 时间序列预测被广泛用于在不确定性条件下为决策提供信息。在许多应用中，这些决策涉及依据尚未被观测到的结果对时间序列进行分类。在本文中，我们提出了Foreclassing，这是一个新的机器学习问题，其中时间序列的类别标签被定义为其未来观测值的函数。我们给出了Foreclassing的数学表述，并建立了刻画该问题的若干理论结果。这些结果描述了额外的未来信息如何影响贝叶斯分类风险，为学习到的Foreclassing模型的分类误差提供了上界，并证明了在训练中使用未来观测值可以带来优于传统分类器的有限样本改进。为了给未来研究提供基准，我们提出了ForeClassNet，这是一类能够同时执行预测和分类的神经网络模型家族。
tldr: 本文提出了“Foreclassing”这一全新机器学习问题，即用时间序列的未来观测值来定义其类别标签，给出了数学表述与相关理论结果，并提出了联合执行预测与分类的神经网络模型家族ForeClassNet作为研究基准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Foreclassing, a new machine learning problem in which a time series' class label is defined as a function of its future observations, establishes theoretical results on Bayes risk and classification error bounds, and proposes ForeClassNet, a family of neural networks that jointly performs forecasting and classification as a benchmark for future research.
